name: TC-CUS-02: Submit Request form shows required validation when submitted empty on Contact Us
fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/UtilityPages/ContactUs.cy.js#UtilityPages - ContactUs [en] — Contact Us TC-CUS-02: Submit Request form shows required validation when submitted empty on Contact Us
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-CUS-02
**Title:** Submit Request form shows required validation when submitted empty on Contact Us
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Open the Contact Us page and click Submit Request with all fields left empty.

**Expected Result:**
The real validation messages for name, mobile, email and message are displayed, and no enquiry is submitted.

**Steps:**
1. Open the Contact Us page
2. Leave all form fields empty
3. Click Submit Request
4. Verify all required-field validation messages are shown
